title: Israeli Strike Hits Ambulance in Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Wounding Two Medics
detail: An Israeli strike hit an ambulance in Nabatieh al-Fawqa, injuring two medics. Lebanon's Health Ministry called the attack a "flagrant violation of international and humanitarian laws and norms." The strike came alongside continued Israeli military activity across the south despite the June 26 framework agreement, with displaced residents in villages such as Ghandouriyeh still clearing rubble from destroyed homes.

media.caption: Residents clear rubble from destroyed homes in Ghandouriyeh village, south Lebanon
